description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Dialog' which renders a modal or non-modal dialog box with positioning logic, event handling for closing on outside click or Escape key, and measurement utilities for positioning. It includes styles, hooks, and a helper function for calculating the dialog's position relative to an anchor element.

methods.name: dialogPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of the dialog element relative to an anchor element, with vertical and horizontal offsets, adjusting to fit within the viewport.
